compute_mesh_face_areas_and_normals: compute the areas and normals of each triangular face in a 3D mesh given vertex and face tensors
compute_face_areas_from_verts_and_faces: compute the area of each triangular face in a mesh using vertex coordinates and face index tensors
compute_face_normals_from_verts_and_face: compute the normal vector of each triangular face in a mesh using vertex coordinates and face index tensors
compute_gradients_for_mesh_face_areas: compute gradients with respect to vertex positions when backpropagating through face area calculations
compute_gradients_for_mesh_face_normals: compute gradients with respect to vertex positions when backpropagating through face normal calculations
